review_type: Independent visual inspection of four actual Gemini UI captures, their full UI proof screenshots, and active Alexia V2

reference.note: Active project V2 reference. Its drafted hidden surfaces are not independent source observations or approval of a generated 3D mesh.

provenance.source_description: Actual Nano Banana raster visible in Gemini image editor UI, extracted as a rectangle from CUA JPEG screenshots and re-encoded as JPEG.
provenance.limitation: This inspection confirms matching visible images and UI proofs; it does not turn screen-resolution JPEGs into original full-resolution exports.

views.actual_view: Straight front; both blue eyes, frontal shirt and belt visible.
observations: Recognizable blue-eyed chibi Alexia with silver-lavender hair, black/white/gold headphones and costume.
Arms extended down/out in an A-pose-like reconstruction draft; empty hands and no suitcase.
Head-to-shoe image span is visibly larger than the other three captures.
Neutral medium-gray background, without visible floor plane, pedestal or contact shadow.
Visible face/costume retain broad V2 identity, but small jewelry, trim and hair-lock details are not exact duplicates.

views.actual_view: Straight back; rear hair, jacket tails and shoe heels visible; no frontal face.
observations: Chibi body and long layered silver-lavender rear hair are recognizable.
Arms are down/out; no suitcase or remnant handle/wheel is visible.
Image subject span is smaller than front and similar to side captures.
Rear hair curl distribution and exposed jacket-tail shapes are draft continuations rather than exact V2 reproduction.
Light lavender-gray background differs from the front's neutral medium gray; no visible floor/contact shadow.
Only one blue eye is visible in a clear side profile.
Upper sleeve is plain/dark where the corresponding V2 profile shows a framed gold star patch and sleeve trim.
Visible hair is a smoother long swept mass; the high tied-root volume does not match the opposite side/V2 construction consistently.
Headphone gold cup center is simplified; the source's small center/ring detail is not consistently discernible at this screen resolution.
Hand sits close to hip/belt level; the same full A-pose as front/back is not established by this projection.
A gold star motif appears on the sock/ankle area; its parity with V2 is not established.
No suitcase, pedestal, floor or contact-shadow remnant is visible.

views.request_label_evidence_note: Request label supplied from root's observed Gemini history; face direction independently confirmed by image inspection. Full UI proof shows the resulting image, not the request text.
observations: Only one blue eye is visible in a clear side profile.
Large blue-gray/gold star on upper sleeve differs from the smaller gold star inside a bordered patch in V2; horizontal source sleeve details are simplified.
A conspicuous separately tied/twisted-looking hair lock descends beside the headphone; this root/lock construction differs from the smoother opposite-side mass and V2.
Hand position near the hip does not establish identical arm pose across the four views.
Sock/ankle star ornament is not established as matching the V2 side design.
No suitcase, pedestal, floor or contact-shadow remnant is visible.

cross_view_checks.view_assignment_note: File labels follow the project's captured-view convention; face directions above are the directly observed facts. Asymmetric sleeve/hair parity still needs reconciliation with V2.

approximate_manual_image_span_estimate.method: Visual estimate from inspected 584x584 captures, not pixel segmentation or exact measured body scale.
approximate_manual_image_span_estimate.finding: Front is roughly ten percent larger in the raster frame than back/sides.
approximate_manual_image_span_estimate.limitation: Cannot infer true world scale or exact proportions from these images alone.

blocking_drift: Normalize subject scale/framing between front and remaining views without changing anatomy.
Reconcile V2 upper-sleeve framed-star patches, straps/trim and new sock-star details across both profiles.
Resolve side hair tied roots/strand masses against one coherent V2 hair construction.
Verify a single unchanged neutral arm/hand pose in all views.
Use the same flat background color; current front/background family differs from other views.
verdict: REVISE AND REINSPECT BEFORE FOUR-VIEW RECONSTRUCTION
front_only_diagnostic_note: A separately labeled front-only controlled reconstruction may be examined as a diagnostic, but it does not establish multiview consistency or approval of these four captures.
next_actions: Keep all four current captures and their UI provenance as actual raster evidence.
Correct the documented scale, pose, hair and patch inconsistencies against V2, one discrepancy at a time.
Inspect corrected actual outputs again before combining four views.
Continue to label original full-resolution PNG export as unavailable unless a genuine export is obtained.
Any eventual 3D acceptance requires actual mesh renders, materials, deformation, six clips, hash identity and in-game evidence.
